fusions.name: Culling Glance
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A glare that deals 18 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Devouring Look
fusions.desc: Stares down a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 10 arcane damage to everything in it, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Marked] for 8 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sizing Up
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Counting Mouthfuls
fusions.desc: Every hit you land marks the target with a stack, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
